name: DATABASE_URL
description: The PostgreSQL database the engine runs on

name: RDM_MODEL_PATH
description: The model file installed on a database's first start; not the active model

name: RDM_CURSOR_SIGNING_KEY
description: Signs pagination cursors; unset, each process makes its own, so cursors stop working after a restart and differ between instances

name: CORS_ORIGINS
description: Browser origins allowed to call the API

name: PUBLIC_URL
description: The engine's address as callers reach it; the issuer of its tokens

name: SOURCE_CODE_URL
description: Where the source of the running version is offered to its users; the project's tag of this version unless set (AGPL section 13)

name: SECRETS_ENCRYPTION_KEY
description: Seals the stored token and webhook signing keys; required

name: JOB_FILE_DIR
description: Where export files wait for download; created at start, kept as long as their job

name: RDM_API_REFERENCE_SCRIPT
description: Where the API reference page at /docs/api loads its script from: bundled or cdn

name: WEB_CONCURRENCY
description: Server worker processes on this instance

name: DATABASE_POOL_SIZE
description: Database connections each process keeps open

name: DATABASE_POOL_MAX_OVERFLOW
description: Database connections each process opens beyond the pool size when busy

name: DATABASE_POOL_TIMEOUT
description: Seconds a request waits for a database connection before it answers 503

name: DATABASE_IDLE_TRANSACTION_TIMEOUT
description: Seconds a connection may sit idle inside a transaction before the database ends it, releasing a stalled process's locks; 0 turns it off

name: LOG_FORMAT
description: How the log is written: text lines, or one JSON object a line

name: LOG_LEVEL
description: The lowest level the log writes

name: PROCESS_HEARTBEAT_SECONDS
description: Seconds between each process's reports of its state to the others

name: MODEL_ADMIN_MUTATIONS_ENABLED
description: Model drafts, compiling, installing and activating releases

name: WORKSPACE_ADMIN_MUTATIONS_ENABLED
description: Creating, renaming, retiring, deleting workspaces and choosing the default

name: INTEGRATION_JOBS_ENABLED
description: Creating and cancelling jobs (POST /batches); job reads stay available

name: CONSUMER_SUBSCRIPTIONS_ENABLED
description: Webhook subscriptions and their delivery

name: BATCH_MAX_ITEMS
description: Items in an inline batch

name: BATCH_MAX_BYTES
description: Bytes in an inline batch's body

name: ATOMIC_JOB_MAX_ITEMS
description: Items in an atomic batch, inline or background

name: BACKGROUND_JOB_MAX_ITEMS
description: Items in a background batch

name: BATCH_BACKGROUND_MAX_BYTES
description: Bytes in a background batch's body

name: JOB_CHUNK_ITEMS
description: Items one background chunk commits

name: IMPORT_MAX_BYTES
description: Bytes in an import's file

name: JOB_PREVIEW_MAX_ITEMS
description: Items a preview of an import or a batch runs before it is a sample

name: MODEL_OPERATION_MAX_ITEMS
description: Operations in one request to a model draft

name: JOB_LEASE_SECONDS
description: Seconds a worker holds a job, renewed with each chunk

name: ACCESS_TOKEN_MINUTES
description: Minutes an access token lasts, for people and clients

name: TOKEN_SIGNING_KEY_DAYS
description: Days a token signing key signs before the next token brings a new one

name: SESSION_IDLE_HOURS
description: Hours a browser session lasts without being used

name: SESSION_DAYS
description: Days a browser session lasts in all before the person signs in again

name: PASSWORD_RESET_HOURS
description: Hours a password-reset link stays valid

name: PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH
description: Characters a local password needs at least; lower only for development

name: JOB_RETENTION_DAYS
description: Days a finished job keeps its outcomes and idempotency key

name: FEED_RETENTION_DAYS
description: Days the change feed and consumer events answer a position

name: CONSUMER_RESOLVE_MAX_ITEMS
description: Items in one consumer batch resolve

name: CONSUMER_WEBHOOK_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS
description: Days the webhook delivery log keeps a request, its body and its attempts

name: AI_PROVIDER
description: The proposal provider: claude, openai-compatible or a factory module:function; empty, the default, sends nothing anywhere

name: AI_MODEL
description: The provider's model; empty for claude means claude-opus-5-5

name: AI_API_KEY
description: The provider's key; never shown

name: AI_BASE_URL
description: The provider's address: required for openai-compatible, empty for Claude's own

name: AI_SEND_LEVEL
description: The most that may leave the instance: structure (no values), samples (a few) or values (as many as a feature needs)

name: AI_SAMPLE_VALUES
description: At send level samples, the most values per column, or rows per sheet, that are sent

name: AI_MIN_CONFIDENCE
description: The confidence, 0 to 1, below which a proposal is not offered

name: AI_LOG_CONTENT
description: Keep each call's request and answer for an operator debugging a prompt

name: AI_LOG_CONTENT_DAYS
description: Days a call's kept request and answer stay, when AI_LOG_CONTENT is on

name: AI_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
description: Seconds one call to the provider may take before it fails

name: AI_REASONING_EFFORT
description: openai-compatible only: how much the model reasons first, none, low, medium or high; empty sends nothing. none keeps a local thinking model fast

name: AI_CONTEXT_TOKENS
description: The model's context window in tokens, for a small local model; each call is sized to half of it. Empty: no limit

name: AI_TASK_RETENTION_DAYS
description: Days an assistant task is kept after it finished (loaded, failed or cancelled) or was last changed; then it and its file are deleted

name: AI_AGENT_COMMAND
description: The command that starts the assistant's Claude Code session, for example: claude --model sonnet; empty, the assistant runs no session

name: AI_AGENT_SANDBOX
description: container when the engine runs in a container, where Claude Code's own sandbox cannot run; empty, the operating system's sandbox

name: AI_AGENT_API_URL
description: The API address the assistant's session uses; empty, this instance's own

name: MCP_ENABLED
description: Whether assistants can reach the instance at /mcp; off, the endpoint does not exist

name: MCP_RATE_PER_MINUTE
description: Tool calls one person or client may make through /mcp in a minute

name: MCP_OPEN_REGISTRATION
description: Whether an assistant may register itself; off, only those an administrator registers can sign people in

name: MCP_REDIRECT_HOSTS
description: HTTPS hosts a self-registered assistant may return to, besides this computer

name: MCP_CALLS_DAYS
description: Days a record of a tool call through /mcp is kept

name: MCP_ANSWER_BYTES
description: The longest answer of a tool through /mcp; past it a page comes back smaller, with a cursor
